Your AI agent fixed this bug yesterday. Today, another agent makes the same mistake.
Maybe the problem isn't always model intelligence. It's memory.
@EntelligenceAI is building shared memory for coding agents, connecting past sessions, PRs, tickets and incidents.

Teams see 53% fewer repeat errors.
Agents should build on past lessons, not repeat them.

item.description:
Demand for basic AI skills in job postings peaked in January 2026, then fell 25%. Demand for hands-on AI building skills rose 51% over roughly the same stretch.
The prompting course many companies rolled out last year is already losing market value. The skill employers now want takes longer to teach, and companies are asking for less of the people who would teach it.
I read four sets of 2026 workforce numbers this month. Together they describe a skills gap that has moved inside the company.
